description: React Native component for a customizable input field with validation, error handling, and optional UI features like secure text toggle and error messages.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation based on validationType, updates error states accordingly.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles text change, triggers validation, manages error display.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles input blur event, updates focus state.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles input focus event, updates focus state.
